page.content:
Absentee-king's brother who becomes the legend's tyrant.

How Prince John connects

  • Artist: King Richard — Richard's return undoes John's usurpation in the later plot.
  • Artist: Sheriff of Nottingham — Later tales make Prince John the sheriff's royal cover.

What is Prince John?

Prince John enters mainly in later retellings as the usurping prince while Richard is on crusade. He raises taxes and shields the sheriff; the early ballads barely need him.

Key threads lead to King Richard and Sheriff of Nottingham.
